assertions: The response routes the mutation-generation task to the specialized-workflows sub-skill, not to a cancer-mutation lookup.
The response runs or references the bundled read-only helper scripts/validate_mutation_inputs.py with --fasta, --mutations, --mut-column mutation, and --seq-id-column seq_ID.
The response reports the preflight result including unmatched sequence ID ENSM1 and matched_row_count 2 for the given fixtures.
The response explains gget's FASTA join normalization as the first title token with the dot version removed (ENST1 from >ENST1.4 description), per mutation-contract.md.
The response treats the unmatched row as an input error to fix rather than guessing a join, and does not mutate or overwrite the input files.
The response does not direct the user to the original gget source repository checkout.
